Its investment and development work built his wealth. Evans died in Monaco in November 2023, aged 87.

long_biography.plain_text:
Evans of Leeds began with Michael White Evans's father, who rejected the family tailoring trade for transport and later entered housebuilding and property. Michael became the active successor, serving as chairman and chief executive while the group developed and invested across northern England.

His defining corporate decision came in 1999, when the Evans family bought the listed company back into private ownership for £164 million. The group subsequently sold major investments near the top of the property cycle and resumed buying as valuations softened. Evans also retained significant control over the holding company through trustees. His life ended in the principality on 28 November 2023.

uncertainties.detail: Companies House confirms January 1936 and a Leeds business writer describes Evans as Yorkshire-born, but no reliable public source located gives his exact birth day or birth town. A low-quality owner aggregator's day-level claim was excluded.

Reliable reporting establishes that Evans's father began the business and that Michael later led it, but does not publish the date or legal mechanism by which leadership and ownership passed to him. The dossier therefore classifies inherited and expanded wealth without inventing a succession date.

The chairman-and-chief-executive title is documented separately from Companies House records of significant control through trustees. The dossier does not convert those records into personal title to every group property or investment.

The death-notice page header displays 28 December 2023, but the notice text states 28 November 2023. The November date is used because it is independently matched by Companies House cessation records and the contemporaneous business obituary.
Evans died in 2023. Primary industry therefore describes his principal business platform at the end of his life, not a present personal operating role.
No exact personal LinkedIn, Instagram, personal website or other social profile was verified. The official company website is proposed separately and is not represented as a personal account.
Private-family trivia, allegations, legal matters, controversy, unverified wealth estimates, vessel research and namesake material are excluded from the biography and evidence ledger.
